title: TAI public non-TAI ACL repair v2
objective: Replace the failed inventory query with a stable exact-current owner-only repair that removes only the two explicit PostgreSQL PUBLIC ACL sources responsible for tai_runtime effective access to non-TAI relations, performs live and durable acceptance, and restores the exact privileges on any failure.
boundaries: The only production command is /tai repair-public-non-tai-acls-v2 current-main on issue 3365
Exact current main must already have successful TAI Controller Sync and TAI REG.RU Preflight statuses
Transport is pinned to the existing REG.RU root SSH authority and host fingerprint
The repair requires exactly two effective non-TAI relations and proves PUBLIC-only attribution with zero direct tai_runtime ACLs and zero ownership
Only explicit PUBLIC relation and column ACL entries on non-TAI relations in schema public may change
Rollback SQL is generated before mutation and restores privilege type and grant option
Any failed live, durable PostgreSQL, audit or outbox acceptance triggers rollback
No role deletion, object deletion, DROP OWNED, REASSIGN OWNED, tenant mutation, application deployment or model mutation
REG.RU only and zero new recurring cost
